checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.
They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”
The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.
The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

wikipediaActualRead.title: Negev
wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事のBiblical節は聖書のNegebの範囲が現代ネゲブより北側に限られた可能性と、語の「南」という用法を記す。民数記13:17のSouthが地名か方位かは本文だけでは確定しない。

geographyAssessmentJa: 広域の聖書的候補域として範囲を明示するなら既存候補を保持可能。ただし13:17は方位語の可能性があり、現代ネゲブの範囲・一点と同一視しない。
